description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] and [Last Stand] to all allies, grants [High Quick Cast 1]/[High Quick Cast 1] and [Weakness +15% Boost (15s)]/[High Quick Cast 1] and [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to the user/all allies/all allies if 0/2/4+ FF2 allies are alive, grants [Awoken Monk] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Awoken Monk
description.text: Monk abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time
